dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters exhibit irregular, jagged, and serrated geometries. These structures show a sharp high-contrast gradient from the dark-gray exterior to the off-white light interior, particularly prominent in the mid-lateral and anterior sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, localized solid light-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior-dorsal region, transitioning to more isolated, larger diffused light-intensity blobs in the posterior-mid region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent closed-loop annuli in the mid-left quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of four high-intensity blobs along the upper dorsal ridge forms a roughly linear longitudinal path with near-equidistant spacing.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a bright blue, textured artificial object (surgical glove) in the upper-left corner of the frame, partially occluding the anterior dorsal surface.
